formattedAddress: No. 52號, Section 2, Zhongshan N Rd, Min'an Village, Zhongshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 104

displayName.text: Itamae Wagyu Teppanyaki Taipei Zhongshan N. Branch

text.text:
First time trying teppanyaki at Itamae Wagyu Teppanyaki Taipei Zhongshan N. Branch (阪前鐵板燒 台北中山北店) and the dining experience was wonderful.

The ingredients were very fresh and the A5 wagyu literally melts in your mouth. Watching the chef prepare everything right in front of us made the meal even more enjoyable. Service was also attentive and professional.

At TWD 1880 per pax, I think it’s really worth it for the quality and experience. Highly rated for a reason — reservation is required as it’s very popular. Highly recommended if you’re in Taipei!

text.text:
So worth coming here! Since we love good Wagyu and seafood, this was the perfect choice for us as a couple.
First of all, the hospitality was excellent. The staff were very friendly, and I had a personal reason to be careful with certain cooking styles. They did their best to accommodate my request, which I really appreciated. All the food was fresh, and the portions were generous—we were completely full by the end of the meal. The dessert was also delicious.

Although they didn’t speak much English to explain each dish, it was clear that they tried their best to take care of us, and we were very happy with their service. You can pay by card, and they continuously refilled free tea, which was a nice touch.

text.text: Must visit in Taipei for Teppanyaki.  The restaurant offers a visually stunning, multi-course teppanyaki experience using fresh premium ingredients.  Nice vibe and cosy atmosphere here.   Reservations is a MUST as they are mostly fully booked most days and most time slots.  Special shoutout to chef Jill who took the trouble to explain in English specifics about each dishes, ingredients and how to enjoy each dish.   Thanks also to service staff Sandy for her attentive and top notch service. We will come back here again if  we visit Taipei!

text.text:
This teppanyaki restaurant it's one of the better restaurant that has a high CP value.
All their dishes taste above average with the exception of wagyu beef. Which is sad to say that it has tendon in the beef which caused the texture and taste not as satisfying. Most likely the beef is from Australia.
Their king crab it is freshly frozen on the boat where it they were caught. This locking the umami  flavor. The only drawback is that the crap meat sticks to the shell.
The abalone is fresh and taste good and tender.
The fish and lobster tail we're okay
